log.text: No full housing-plus-all-hoses street kit. Marine housing is Mercury 861493A07 / Sierra 18-1910 (cast housing, stat separate). Pump hose Sierra 18-70931 / Mercury 32-96879 is boat circulating-pump hose. Manifold and transom hoses are boat. This car's radiator hose is already Gates 26502. Look at this housing first — Buck's industrial 181 may not be the marine two-piece. 18-1993 is a V8 housing. Not bought.

spec.Housing kit: Marine housing is Mercury 861493A07 / Sierra 18-1910, MCM 140/3.0L s/n 0L340999 and below. Cast housing + gaskets. Stat is separate (18-3650). Not read on this engine. https://www.marineengine.com/newparts/part_details.php?pnum=MER861493A07
spec.Hoses: No one SKU is housing + all hoses + stat for this street radiator. Marine pump hose is Sierra 18-70931 / Mercury 32-96879. Manifold and transom hoses are boat. This car's radiator hose is already Gates 26502.
spec.Bolt-on: If this housing is still the marine two-piece, unbolt the cover and drop in 18-3650. If the casting is junk, 18-1910 replaces the housing. Look at this engine first — Buck's industrial 181 may not have the boat housing.
spec.Not: Not TDL 5216 (C/HOUSING on the 2011 heater-hose ticket). Not Sierra 18-1993 (V8 305/350 housing). Not the Flex-a-lite fan 'adjustable thermostat' on 400-110. Not the valve-cover gasket 18-0347.

log.text: Opened the housing. No thermostat. Hollow, straight into the engine. That is a deleted stat, not a special open housing. PSI industrial 3.0L is supposed to have a thermostat between the water-outlet neck and the housing. Coolant is unrestricted, so this JEGS street radiator can run the engine cold. Sierra 18-3650 marine analog is not confirmed for this seat. Measure flange OD / ID / depth before buying. Not bought.

spec.This one: Read on the car 9 Nov 2026. Housing opened. No thermostat. Hollow, straight into the engine. Coolant is unrestricted.
spec.Means: The stat was pulled, or never installed. Full flow all the time. Engine can run cold on the JEGS street radiator. Warm-up, heater, and oil temp stay low until a thermostat goes back in.
spec.PSI industrial: PSI 3.0L industrial manual: thermostat sits between the water-outlet neck and the housing that bolts to the block. Empty is not the design. Housing bolts 38 N·m / 28 lb-ft. Outlet bolts 28 N·m / 21 lb-ft.
spec.Need: Measure the flange seat (OD / ID / depth). Spring toward the engine. Do not buy 18-3650 until that seat matches the marine 59078. A parts-store 180°/195° GM stat is the usual industrial/street piece — not locked until measured.
spec.18-3650: Sierra 18-3650 / NAPA SME183650 was the marine 140° analog. Not in this housing. Not the lock.
spec.WINCO sheet: PSI Z33001814 is on the WINCO GM 3.0L sheet. Opening temp is not printed. One reseller titles Z33001814 as a belt, so that number is not locked.
spec.Housing kit: Marine 861493A07 / Sierra 18-1910 is a boat housing. This engine already has a housing. Do not replace it just because it is empty.
spec.Not: Not TDL 5216 (C/HOUSING on the 2011 heater-hose ticket). Not Sierra 18-1993 (V8). Not the Flex-a-lite fan 'adjustable thermostat' on 400-110.

log.text: Housing inside is corroded. Replace it. Sold 181 kit is Sierra 18-1910 / Mercury 861493A07. Lower only Barr MC-29-47587 with gasket Sierra 18-0164. Count hose bosses on the old casting: extra pump/manifold nipples = marine kit. One 1-3/4 radiator neck only = industrial, marine kit is wrong. New neck must take Gates 26502. Stat still not locked. Not bought.

spec.This one: Read on the car 9 Nov 2026. Housing opened. No thermostat. Hollow into the engine. Inside is corroded. Replace the housing. Coolant is unrestricted until a new stat goes in with it.
spec.Housing: Sold 181 kit: Sierra 18-1910 / Mercury 861493A07. Cast housing. Page $122–$193. https://www.marineengine.com/newparts/part_details.php?pnum=MER861493A07
spec.Lower only: Barr MC-29-47587, the base that bolts to the block. ~$74. Palmer: https://palmerpower.com/barr-mc-29-47587-mercruiser-lower-thermostat-housing/ Upper cover Barr MC-29-60372 if buying pieces.

spec.Stat: Still none in it. Seat the new thermostat in the new housing. 18-3650 marine 140° only if this is the marine seat. Not locked.
spec.WINCO sheet: PSI Z33001814 is on the WINCO GM 3.0L sheet. Opening temp is not printed. One reseller titles Z33001814 as a belt, so that number is not locked.
spec.Not: Not TDL 5216. Not Sierra 18-1993 (V8). Not Chevy II 3877660 (V8 water neck). Not the Flex-a-lite fan thermostat on 400-110.

log.text: 861493A07 photo is the lower body. Top cover is a separate lid. Old Mercury 60372A2 COVER ASSEMBLY was superseded into this kit. Barr still sells the cover alone as MC-29-60372 / Sierra 18-1969. Lower alone is Barr MC-29-47587. Sierra 18-1910 is the same two-piece kit. MarineEngine 18-1993 equivalent is V8, ignore it. Not bought.

spec.This one: Read on the car 9 Nov 2026. Housing opened. No thermostat. Hollow into the engine. Inside is corroded. Replace the housing. Coolant is unrestricted until a new stat goes in with it.
spec.Two pieces: Marine 181 housing is a lower body plus a top cover. Thermostat sits between them. The MarineEngine photo is the lower body only. The lid is a separate casting.
spec.Kit: Mercury 861493A07 / Sierra 18-1910 is both halves. Sierra catalog replaces 47587, 47587A2, 47588, 60372A1, 60372A2, 63908A2. Mercury superseded the old cover 60372A2 into this kit. Page $122–$193. https://www.marineengine.com/newparts/part_details.php?pnum=MER861493A07
spec.Lower: What the photo shows. Bolts to the block. Hose bosses. Barr MC-29-47587, bare lower only. ~$74. Palmer: https://palmerpower.com/barr-mc-29-47587-mercruiser-lower-thermostat-housing/
spec.Cover: Top lid, not in the kit photo. Old Mercury 60372A2 COVER ASSEMBLY, ~1.25 lb. Mercury no longer sells it alone. Barr MC-29-60372 / Sierra 18-1969 still sold. Hardin: https://www.hardin-marine.com/p-113746-mercruiser-4-and-6-cylinder-upper-thermostat-housing.aspx
spec.Confirm: Count hose bosses on the old casting. Extra pump / manifold nipples = marine, 18-1910 fits. One 1-3/4 radiator neck only = industrial PSI outlet, marine kit is wrong. This car's hose is Gates 26502 1-3/4 — the new neck has to take that cuff.
spec.Stat: Still none in it. Seat the new thermostat in the new housing. 18-3650 marine 140° only if this is the marine seat. Not locked.
spec.WINCO sheet: PSI Z33001814 is on the WINCO GM 3.0L sheet. Opening temp is not printed. One reseller titles Z33001814 as a belt, so that number is not locked.
spec.Not: Not TDL 5216. Not Sierra 18-1993 (V8) — MarineEngine lists it as an equivalent of 861493A07; it is not. Not Chevy II 3877660 (V8 water neck). Not the Flex-a-lite fan thermostat on 400-110.
